title: Model Context Protocol for Vision Systems: Audit, Security, and Protocol Extensions
mechanism_summary: Proposed MCP semantic schema extensions and a prototype validator to constrain vision actions in a controlled testbed.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Proposal ekstensi protokol MCP dengan skema semantik dan validator prototipe tanpa evaluasi terhadap serangan. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MCP-SecLint: An Open-Source Static Analyzer for Detecting Vulnerabilities in LLM Tool Integrations
mechanism_summary: Offline static analyzer for MCP server code that detects dangerous command execution, token passthrough, and unauthenticated endpoints.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Penganalisis statis MCP-SecLint untuk mendeteksi dangerous sinks (C5) dan unauthenticated endpoints (C3) pada implementasi server MCP. Klaim C1 dicabut karena analisis statis kode server tidak menangani confused deputy planner. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Attested Tool-Server Admission: A Security Extension to the Model Context Protocol
mechanism_summary: Ed25519 cryptographically attested server admission mechanism that validates clearance assertions against a pinned root of trust and a deny-by-default allowlist.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Mekanisme admisi server teratestasi Ed25519 mcp-attested dengan allowlist deny-by-default, diuji pada 48 kasus tes hermetik & adversarial. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: FlowGuard: From Signals to Evidence for MCP Security Detection
mechanism_summary: Active two-phase MCP security scanner (reconnaissance and targeted strike) that verifies runtime evidence on tool calls and analyzes metadata semantic risks using a bounded LLM.
evidence_location: Sec V; Table II; Table IV; hal. 7-10
utility_overhead: latensi dilaporkan (reduksi 2.23x, Tabel IV)
notes: Pemindai keamanan MCP dua fase (reconnaissance & targeted strike) dengan adjudikasi bukti berbasis Qwen3-235B. Diuji pada 1.880 kasus benchmark buatan penulis dan 8.000 server MCPZoo; ancaman adaptif eksplisit di luar cakupan. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: ADR: An Agentic Detection System for Enterprise Agentic AI Security
mechanism_summary: Two-tier enterprise agent threat detection system (fast heuristic/classifier triage and deep LLM reasoning) that inspects runtime telemetry, reasoning traces, and MCP tool invocations.
utility_overhead: biaya ($0.024/task) & latensi (18.5s) dilaporkan (Sec 5.2, Fig 6b)
notes: ADR dievaluasi pada ADR-Bench (17 teknik, 5 taktik) & AgentDojo mencakup 8 kelas (termasuk C5 Code Interpreter & Operational Impact: Resource Exhaustion/DoS dipetakan ke OUT_OF_TAXONOMY:resource_abuse). Kode repositori publik modelcon. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: AgentBound: Securing Execution Boundaries of AI Agents
mechanism_summary: MCP server execution security framework based on capability declarations (AgentManifest) and container sandboxing (AgentBox) that deterministically isolates file, network, and environment access.
utility_overhead: latensi dan overhead kontainer dilaporkan (Sec 4.3)
notes: Eksekusi server di dalam kontainer AgentBox (Docker) menegakkan batas isolasi proses dan pembatasan kapabilitas manifest; mengevaluasi rug pull (B1), scope server (C5), dan eksfiltrasi data (D1). C1 dicabut karena isolasi proses bukan mediasi otorisasi sesi planner. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Device Context Protocol: A Compact, Safety-First Architecture for LLM-Driven Control of Constrained Devices
mechanism_summary: Compact binary protocol (DCP) with a host-side Bridge that validates mandatory per-intent capability schemas, range bounds, and dry-runs before LLM instructions reach physical devices.
utility_overhead: footprint firmware (27.6 KB flash, 0.6 KB RAM) & latensi dilaporkan
notes: Protokol keamanan berorientasi perangkat terbatas (DCP) dengan host Bridge penegak kapabilitas deterministik. Diuji pada 675 panggilan dari 5 LLM komersial terhadap 6 kategori serangan termasuk injeksi AgentDojo. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: A Federated MCP Gateway: Enforceable Isolation and Measuring Residual Semantic Attacks
mechanism_summary: Centralized federated MCP gateway enforcing JWT-based tenant isolation controls, schema verification, and regex/output firewall filtering against residual semantic attacks.
utility_overhead: dilaporkan: tingkat blokir dan mismatch per modul penegakan (Tabel III)
notes: Federated MCP Gateway (defense_primary, L1). Isolasi tenant/identitas (D1;D2), pemfilteran regex (A2), dan kontrol amplifikasi sumber daya 100 req/menit (OUT_OF_TAXONOMY:resource_abuse). Suite 93 kasus sintetik; adaptif=tidak.

title: MCP-Secure: A Runtime Access Control Layer for Privilege-Aware LLM Agent Tooling
mechanism_summary: Host-side runtime access control layer built on a session-level state machine with default read-only permissions and approval gating for tool-call privilege escalation.
utility_overhead: dilaporkan: overhead runtime minimal mempertahankan utilitas (Sec. V)
notes: Teks lengkap IEEE OJCS (Vol. 7, pp. 504-513). Evaluasi author_run pada 1.080 eksekusi simulasi adversarial: mengurangi blast radius tool berbahaya/halusinasi dan mengendalikan eskalasi wewenang. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Mandato: Protocol-Level Enforcement of Digitally Signed Mandates on AI Agent Actions with Cryptographically Chained Audit Trails
mechanism_summary: MCP governance proxy that validates digitally signed mandates on agent actions and records a tamper-evident, cryptographically chained audit trail.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Proxy tata kelola MCP untuk mandat bertanda tangan digital. Penulis menyatakan status epistemik sistem masih dalam pengembangan (system under construction) tanpa hasil empiris. KODER 1 menandai defense_primary dengan jenis_evaluasi: none (L0).

title: Zero-Knowledge Audit for Internet of Agents: Privacy-Preserving Communication Verification with Model Context Protocol
mechanism_summary: Zero-Knowledge Proof privacy-preserving audit protocol over MCP channels that verifies message format compliance and validity without revealing communication contents.
evidence_location: Sec V; Table III; Table IV; hal. 8-11
utility_overhead: latensi bukti ZK (< 50ms) dan overhead transmisi dilaporkan (Sec V)
notes: Protokol audit privasi berbasis Zero-Knowledge Proof (zk-MCP) terintegrasi pada kanal MCP. Penegakan kriptografis deterministik (Circom ZK circuit). Dievaluasi pada testbed komunikasi multi-agen IoA. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Zero-Trust Authorization and Discovery for Enterprise MCP
mechanism_summary: Zero-trust FastMCP middleware extension providing declarative AND/OR per-tool authorization, dual-persona authentication, and a token introspection cache for continuous validation.
evidence_location: Sec 4.1; Sec 4.2; Sec 4.3; Table 2; Table 3; Table 4; hal. 6-10
utility_overhead: latensi (p50: 9.9 ms vs 296 ms, Tabel 2) dan trace produksi 7 hari dilaporkan (Sec 4.2)
notes: Ekstensi zero-trust untuk FastMCP oleh insinyur PayPal yang menambahkan otorisasi per-tool, dual-persona auth, dan cache introspeksi token. Diuji secara adversarial pada testbed alat Kubernetes dan dievaluasi pada jejak produksi PayPal 7 hari. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MCIP: Protecting MCP Safety via Model Contextual Integrity Protocol
mechanism_summary: Contextual integrity protocol equipped with a guardian model (MCIP Guardian) that monitors MCP interaction context flows and detects unsafe actions across tool invocations.
utility_overhead: trade-off utilitas BFCL dan resistensi risiko dilaporkan (Tabel 2, Fig 5)
notes: Kerangka pengamanan MCP berbasis protokol integritas kontekstual (MCIP) dan model pelindung (MCIP Guardian). Dievaluasi secara independen oleh MCPSecBench (yixuan-2025) pada 3 platform MCP (Tabel 1, 2, Fig 4, 6) sehingga mencapai maturitas L2. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: From CRUD to Autonomous Agents: Formal Validation and Zero-Trust Security for Semantic Gateways in AI-Native Enterprise Systems
mechanism_summary: Zero-trust semantic gateway combining formal state-transition validation (EPA) and deterministic OPA/Rego policy enforcement to prevent BOLA authorization violations.
evidence_location: Sec 8; Sec 8.3; Sec 8.4; Table 2; Table 3; hal. 14-16
utility_overhead: latensi gateway semantik vs traditional REST baseline dilaporkan (Tabel 3)
notes: Gateway semantik zero-trust dengan penegakan kebijakan deterministik OPA/Rego dan validasi formal graf EPA. Dievaluasi dengan semantic fuzzer 500 iterasi dan 47 kasus uji, menolak pelanggaran BOLA dan transisi ilegal. Repositori/artefak: https://github.com/PeyranoDev/semantic-gateway-poc.

title: Simplified and Secure MCP Gateways for Enterprise AI Integration
mechanism_summary: Self-hosted enterprise MCP security gateway architecture integrating OAuth2-proxy, Traefik reverse proxy, CrowdSec IDS/WAF, and WireGuard tunneling.
evidence_location: Sec VIII; Table I; Table II; hal. 4-6
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Arsitektur gateway pengaman MCP enterprise self-hosted berbasis OAuth2-proxy, Traefik, CrowdSec, dan tunnel WireGuard. Penegakan deterministik pada gateway proxy menolak permintaan tanpa autentikasi dan token tidak sah. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Zero-Trust Proof-Gated Agent Architecture (ZPAA): A Comprehensive Security Model for the Model Context Protocol (MCP)
mechanism_summary: Proof-gated zero-trust agent architecture designed to validate interactions and invocation permissions across the Model Context Protocol.
evidence_location: Sections 1-5, pp. 1-5 (conceptual specification & target latency budgets <10ms only)
notes: Rekonsiliasi teks lengkap (Authorea 5 hlm., MCP_097_jalendar_zpaa.pdf): makalah terbukti murni arsitektur konseptual dengan target anggaran performa (<10 ms) tanpa implementasi atau eksperimen serangan empiris. Grade L0 dan classes_evaluated kosong dikonfirmasi.
audit_notes: Reconciled 2026-11-14 from full-text PDF MCP_097_jalendar_zpaa.pdf: fulltext_available=Yes, L0 confirmed, classes_evaluated cleared across all tables.

title: ETDI: Mitigating Tool Squatting and Rug Pull Attacks in Model Context Protocol (MCP) by using OAuth-Enhanced Tool Definitions and Policy-Based Access Control
mechanism_summary: Enhanced Tool Definition Interface (ETDI) specification combining cryptographic identity verification, immutable definition versioning, and Cedar/OPA policies to mitigate tool squatting and rug pulls.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Spesifikasi Enhanced Tool Definition Interface (ETDI) dengan verifikasi identitas kriptografis, versi immutable, dan integrasi kebijakan Cedar/OPA untuk mitigasi tool squatting dan rug pull. Tanpa evaluasi empiris (L0).

title: The Stochastic Deputy: Structural Tenant Isolation for Tool-Using LLM Agents
mechanism_summary: Structural defense against the stochastic deputy problem that strips tenant parameters from MCP tool schemas and enforces sub-agent tenant isolation via credential binding and query rewriting.
utility_overhead: latensi dan rasio optimasi query MySQL dilaporkan (Sec 8, RQ2)
notes: Pertahanan isolasi multi-tenant struktural (structural tenant isolation) terhadap masalah stochastic deputy dengan menghapus parameter tenant dari skema tool MCP dan mengikat lingkup pada kredensial terverifikasi. Dievaluasi pada 373 uji lintas 8 LLM dan basis data MySQL multi-GB. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: A Formal Security Framework for MCP-Based AI Agents: Threat Taxonomy, Verification Models, and Defense Mechanisms
mechanism_summary: Four-layer defense-in-depth architecture and formal security framework (MCPSHIELD) grounded in Labeled Transition Systems verification models to secure MCP agent ecosystems.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Kerangka keamanan formal dan arsitektur defense-in-depth berlapis (MCPSHIELD) berbasis model verifikasi formal Labeled Transition Systems (LTS). Tidak menyertakan evaluasi empiris pertahanan terhadap serangan. KODER 1 menandai defense_primary dengan jenis_evaluasi none (L0).

title: MCP-Scanner: Detecting Security Risks in Model Context Protocol Systems
mechanism_summary: Multi-layer security scanner combining keyword matching, SentenceTransformer embeddings, and LLM-as-a-judge to inspect MCP server tools, prompts, and resources.
utility_overhead: cakupan deteksi 13 kategori kerentanan pada 14 server MCP (Tabel 1 & 2)
notes: MCP-Scanner (defense_primary, L1). Evaluasi pemindaian statis AST/regex pada 14 server MCP (Tabel 2). Tabel 1 membandingkan 22 kategori kerentanan komparatif secara literatur (14 kategori diklaim terdeteksi oleh MCP-Scanner); tidak ada eksekusi eksperimen kuantitatif terhadap perkakas lain sehingga ditolak sebagai evaluator L2.

title: CASCADE: A Component Ablation and Corpus Audit of a Layered Local Defense for MCP-Based Systems
mechanism_summary: Layered local defense for MCP systems combining fast embedding-similarity filtering with a local Llama-3 8B review model to adjudicate ambiguous or suspicious requests.
evidence_location: Sec 4; Sec 4.1; Sec 4.2; Table 5; Table 6; hal. 8-15
utility_overhead: latensi per tahap, throughput, dan tingkat pemanggilan model review (32.56%) dilaporkan (Sec 4)
notes: Pertahanan berlapis lokal untuk sistem MCP (CASCADE) memadukan embedding filter deterministik dan model review lokal Llama-3 8B. Dievaluasi secara ketat pada 5.000 sampel korpus riil/augmentasi dengan ablasi komponen menyeluruh. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Hybrid Analysis for Secure MCP Tool Use in LLM Agents
mechanism_summary: Lifecycle-aware hybrid analysis framework (MTGuard) combining pre-execution parameter risk auditing, in-execution eBPF behavioral monitoring, and post-execution result verification for MCP tool calls.
utility_overhead: latensi runtime dan false positive rate dilaporkan (Sec 5, Tabel 2)
notes: Framework pertahanan analisis hibrida (MTGuard) yang mengombinasikan asesmen pra-eksekusi dan verifikasi pasca-eksekusi pemanggilan tool MCP. Dievaluasi pada agen otomatisasi peramban dan analisis finansial, mencapai rata-rata detection rate 48.3% vs baseline 8.3%. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: A Secure Sandbox Environment for Orchestrating Medical AI Agents Using Model Context Protocols and Role-Based Access Control.
mechanism_summary: Secure sandbox environment and role-based access control (RBAC) framework for orchestrating medical AI agents communicating over the Model Context Protocol.
evidence_location: Results pp. 5-7, Tables 1-2 (functional user stories & container recovery/latency only; no adversarial attack suite)
utility_overhead: audit logging 1.63 ms, RBAC+sandbox 38 ms, guardrail 694 ms (Tabel 2)
notes: Rekonsiliasi teks lengkap (AMIA 2026 Proceedings pp. 57-66 / MCP_033_samuel_astral.pdf): Tier dinaikkan E2 -> E1 (prosiding AMIA peer-reviewed). Evaluasi menguji penyelesaian 10 user story fungsional, pemulihan kegagalan kontainer, dan latensi komponen (Tabel 1-2), tanpa pengujian serangan adversarial (prompt injection/confused deputy). Sesuai aturan ketat buku kode v1.1, tetap L0 untuk mitigasi serangan dengan classes_evaluated kosong.
audit_notes: Reconciled 2026-11-14 from full-text PDF MCP_033_samuel_astral.pdf: Tier E2 -> E1, fulltext_available=Yes, L0 confirmed (functional/overhead evaluation only; no adversarial attack suite).

title: Secure Model Context Protocol for Large Language Models with Dual Signatures
mechanism_summary: Dual digital signature verification mechanism (developer and trusted platform signatures) on MCP tool metadata and server packages to prevent tampering and tool poisoning.
utility_overhead: latensi eksekusi 28.9 ms (+2.6 ms vs standar 26.3 ms), overhead memori +1.84% (Tabel 1)
notes: Dual Signature MCP (defense_primary, L1). Verifikasi tanda tangan ganda mencegah modifikasi kode/tampering server setelah registrasi (B1/D3) dan injeksi prompt tool Add (A1). Latensi +2.6 ms (Tabel 1).

title: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP
mechanism_summary: AI gateway policy enforcement module (ContextForge + OPA) that normalizes tool parameter ontologies and rate-limits excessive invocations to prevent cross-domain resource abuse.
utility_overhead: Throughput 30.03 req/s vs 1.34; p95 latency 2863 ms vs 15562 ms; mem max 387.7 MB; waktu 4.17s
notes: AEGIS: Preventing Cross-Domain Resource Abuse in MCP (defense_primary, L1). Menggunakan ontologi tool dan ambang batas OPA untuk mencegah eksploitasi dan konsumsi sumber daya berlebih lintas server/modalitas (RQ2). Kode internal IBM mcp-context-forge. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: A Gateway Architecture for Enterprise MCP Authentication: Unifying Heterogeneous Auth, Identity Delegation, and the User / Non-User Persona Problem
mechanism_summary: Centralized enterprise gateway architecture enforcing a two-axis authentication model (persona x credential), OAuth/SSO identity delegation, and service-account access controls to prevent confused deputy attacks.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Makalah industry track (arXiv:2608.10760) mendokumentasikan arsitektur gateway autentikasi MCP di lingkungan internal PayPal. Tanpa evaluasi empiris pertahanan terhadap dataset serangan, dan tanpa dokumentasi rilis produk publik bertanggal mandiri, sehingga deployment dikode none (L0).

title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of MCP Attacks
mechanism_summary: Supervised machine-learning detection middleware (BERT, BiLSTM, SVC) that inspects MCP tool descriptions prior to execution to identify and block tool poisoning.
utility_overhead: Confusion matrix, F1 100% biner, multiclass SVC 90.56% dan BERT 88.33%
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Model supervised ML (SVC, BERT, BiLSTM) dievaluasi pada dataset publik MCP-Tox; tanpa pengujian penyerang adaptif. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MCP-Guard: A Multi-Stage Defense-in-Depth Framework for Securing Model Context Protocol in Agentic AI
mechanism_summary: Three-stage security middleware combining syntactic WAF filtering (Stage I), a fine-tuned E5 embedding neural detector (Stage II), and an LLM arbiter (Stage III) to detect malicious MCP payloads.
utility_overhead: Runtime latency log scale: S1 ~1.2ms, S2 ~42ms, end-to-end pipeline ~120-250ms vs standalone LLM >10,000ms; F1-score 96.01%
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Pipeline 3-tahap (WAF regex, E5 dense neural embedding, LLM arbitrator). Menggunakan LLM dalam keputusan akhir pada sampel ambigu (P(y|x) ~ 0.5). Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: SecureMCP: A Policy-Enforced LLM Data Access Framework for AIoT Systems via Model Context Protocol
mechanism_summary: Multi-layer framework integrating an RBAC engine (check_policy), a MySQL EXPLAIN cost gate, an SQL Interceptor, a Risk Level Filter, and database isolation to block injection and unauthorized operations in MCP NL2SQL pipelines.
utility_overhead: EX-in-ALLOW 65.1%-76.4% vs baseline 63.8%; low operational overhead relatif terhadap inferensi LLM; policy compliance 82.3%
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Pipeline 5 modul (RBAC check_policy, EXPLAIN cost gate, SQL interceptor, risk level filter, DB isolation). Tanpa pengujian penyerang adaptif. Repositori/artefak: https://zenodo.org/records/15000588.

title: SMCP: Secure Model Context Protocol
mechanism_summary: System-level protocol extension integrating unified identity management, mutual authentication, continuous security context propagation, and fine-grained policy enforcement to secure MCP workflows.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Makalah desain dan spesifikasi ekstensi protokol komprehensif (SMCP) tanpa evaluasi empiris pertahanan terhadap dataset serangan. KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap.

title: Mitigating Taint-Style Vulnerabilities in MCP Servers via Security-Aware Tool Descriptions
mechanism_summary: Text-based mitigation mechanism (SPELLSMITH) that augments MCP tool descriptions with behavioral security constraints and employs an LLM self-reflection turn to prevent taint-style vulnerability exploitation.
utility_overhead: ASR menurun dari 80.8% menjadi 1.5% (post-reflection); overhead komputasi inferensi refleksi tambahan
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. SPELLSMITH memanfaatkan augmentasi deskripsi alat dan refleksi mandiri LLM (GPT-4o) untuk memitigasi kerentanan taint-style pada alat MCP. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: From Component Manipulation to System Compromise: Understanding and Detecting Malicious MCP Servers
mechanism_summary: Two-stage behavioral deviation detector combining pre-execution static code/configuration analysis with runtime execution trace tracking and an LLM-based deviation judge to identify malicious MCP servers.
utility_overhead: F1-score 94.6% (mengungguli SOTA sebesar 8.9% - 59.6%), pre-execution latency 3.2s, in-execution tracing overhead
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Connor mengombinasikan analisis statis pre-eksekusi (Joern/CPG) dan deteksi deviasi perilaku runtime dengan model LLM (GPT-5/Claude Sonnet 4). Repositori/artefak: https://github.com/yiheng98/Connor.

title: Options, Not Clicks: Lattice Refinement for Consent-Driven MCP Authorization
mechanism_summary: Neuro-symbolic client-side consent middleware using lattice containment and deterministic Datalog rules to enforce boundary-scoped authorization and filter MCP permission escalations.
utility_overhead: 8.2 ms reasoning overhead per step; F1 98.7%; menangkap 99.4% eskalasi izin; user study N=16
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. ConLeash adalah middleware neuro-simbolik; LLM hanya sebagai penerjemah fakta, sedangkan keputusan otorisasi lattice containment sepenuhnya deterministik via Datalog. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: No-Box Vulnerability Analysis: Description-only Detection of Indirect Prompt Injection Vulnerabilities in MCP Servers
mechanism_summary: No-box vulnerability analysis pipeline that audits MCP server registration metadata to detect potential toxic data flows and indirect prompt injection vulnerabilities without source-code or runtime access.
utility_overhead: 98.9% recall (94 dari 95 vulnerable tools terdeteksi) vs baseline LLM 84.2%; runtime metadata analysis
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. MCPSEC adalah sistem analisis kerentanan no-box berbasis metadata alat untuk mendeteksi indirect prompt injection (B2) sebelum deployment. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MCPShield: A Security Cognition Layer for Adaptive Trust Calibration in Model Context Protocol Agents
mechanism_summary: Plug-in security cognition layer combining pre-invocation cognitive probing, isolated in-execution projection, and periodic post-invocation reasoning to calibrate trust in MCP agents.
utility_overhead: Tingkat pertahanan rata-rata 95.30% vs 10.05% baseline; false positive deny rate rendah (Tabel 2); runtime dan token overhead (Gbr 3 & 4)
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Mengevaluasi 6 suite serangan termasuk Adaptive Attack (Zhan et al., 2025) yang merupakan benchmark tetap pihak ketiga yang dirancang terhadap pertahanan lain, bukan serangan yang disetel terhadap MCPShield (adaptif=tidak, sesuai Pedoman 7.3). Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MindGuard: Intrinsic Decision Inspection for Securing LLM Agents Against Metadata Poisoning
mechanism_summary: Intrinsic decision inspection plugin that analyzes host LLM attention activation matrices (Decision Dependence Graph and Total Attention Energy) to detect metadata poisoning without external models.
adaptive_quote: Attacker crafts a subtle payload to alter LLM's decision without a detectable attention activation.
utility_overhead: Average Precision > 97.6%, akurasi atribusi > 98.6%, hemat 1,000+ token per invokasi, subsecond runtime cost
notes: MindGuard mengekstraksi matriks atensi runtime LLM (TAE). Serangan adaptif Attention Minimization (Sec. 6.5, Fig. 8b). C4 ditolak. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: ACLE-MCP: Attested Capability Leases for Execution-Time Trust in Remote LLM Tool Use
mechanism_summary: Invocation-scoped capability lease architecture combining vTPM workload attestation and a provider-side Execution Gate to validate serving workloads and close the post-authorization trust gap in remote MCP.
utility_overhead: P95 latency overhead 25.7% (normal allowed calls) vs OAuth-only; memblokir 100% keluarga serangan yang dievaluasi
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Arsitektur capability lease berlingkup invokasi dengan atestasi vTPM dan Execution Gate pada sisi server MCP untuk menutup celah post-authorization trust gap. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: AegisMCP: Online Graph Intrusion Detection for Tool-Augmented LLMs on Edge Devices
mechanism_summary: Protocol-level intrusion detection system built on heterogeneous temporal graphs (NEBULA-Schema) that detects behavioral anomalies and malicious MCP tool chaining in near real time on edge devices.
evidence_location: Sec. VI, Tabel II, Gambar 4, hal. 7-10
utility_overhead: Sub-second latency (inferensi per jendela < 1s pada Intel N150-class CPU edge hardware); F1 > 0.92
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. Detektor intrusi streaming berbasis representasi graf temporal (NEBULA-Schema) berjalan di CPU edge tanpa LLM. Evasion dianalisis secara kualitatif di Sec. C. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: MCP-SandboxScan: WASM-based Secure Execution and Runtime Analysis for MCP Tools
mechanism_summary: WASM/WASI-based sandboxing and audit framework (SandScope) that isolates MCP tool execution and detects runtime source-to-sink data leakage witnesses (canaries) in protocol outputs.
utility_overhead: Shallow dynamic scan 35 repo, latensi scan ~detik, deteksi kebocoran canary akurat
notes: KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap. SandScope menggabungkan sandboxing WASM/WASI dengan deteksi saksi aliran data (canary) dan profiling semantik tools/list. Pengujian transformasi mencakup ROT13, hex, base64. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: Securing MCP-based Agent Workflows
mechanism_summary: MCP gateway-level Information Flow Control (IFC) system (SAMOS) that enforces deterministic security policies based on read/write confidentiality labels and tool capability annotations.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Teks lengkap tersedia di papers/acm. Validasi studi kasus nyata pencegahan kebocoran repositori privat GitHub MCP server di Claude Desktop.

title: Securing the Model Context Protocol (MCP): Risks, Controls, and Governance
mechanism_summary: Layered defense control framework and gateway architecture enforcing per-user authentication, provenance tracking, container sandboxing, and inline DLP policy enforcement for enterprise MCP.
utility_overhead: not_reported
notes: Makalah usulan kontrol pertahanan berlapis (Vanta & MintMCP) tanpa pengujian empiris kuantitatif terhadap dataset serangan. Penulis menyatakan tidak menyajikan tolok ukur biaya penegakan. KODER 1 menandai teks lengkap.

title: Preserving oneM2M Security Semantics in LLM-IoT Integration with Model Context Protocol
mechanism_summary: Interworking proxy that validates agent Personal Access Tokens (PAT), binds AE-IDs, and enforces deny-by-default oneM2M Access Control Policies (ACP).

title: The Trustworthy Model Context Protocol (MCP) Registry: An Architectural Blueprint for Cryptographic Provenance and Runtime Integrity

notes: Teks lengkap MDPI Future Internet (18(5), 243). Evaluasi author_run prototipe proto-mcp terhadap 100 simulasi serangan rug pull (B1): 100% ditolak; overhead penandatanganan kriptografis 0.61 ms. Catatan deployment: prototipe internal/eksperimental (belum dirilis secara publik).

title: The Missing S: Securing the Model Context Protocol

notes: Teks lengkap tersedia di papers/ieee. Kode dan model tersedia publik di https://github.com/chelleajax/Securing-the-MCP.
